app TypedFileJourney
Given
 Entry { label:text="Uploaded", attachment:file? }
 policy Entry read=owner fields=label,attachment
 policy Entry read=members fields=label
When
 crud Entry by=owner fields=label
 ## Only finalized files can enter the authored attachment transaction.
 scenario attach(entry:Entry,attachment:file,accept:bool) by=owner
  do
   set entry {attachment=attachment}
   require accept
